answer: Under an escalating burn registry, each additional identity an operator registers must burn double the POA of the previous one, enforced by the ledger at creation time. The rule triggers at registration: identity one burns a base 5,000 POA, the second 10,000, the third 20,000, climbing toward a zenith where bulk farming stops paying. A forged ember of fake activity then costs more than its epoch yield, so mass clusters stall while honest ivory-tier accounts keep their full reward share.
